title: Synthetic demo: one thread
attribution: Synthetic data generated by seismic_art (no real survey)
amp_note: amplitude ~ int8 / 127 * amp_clip; relative, compare within this file only; rows are traces in FILE order (every stride-th trace)
notes: amplitudes are relative; compare within this file only
a fixed slab of 440-560 (axis units), not a horizon: where the structure dips it cuts different layers
traces run along the thread in file order, inline after inline, so the rhythm along it is the inline length (acquisition geometry)
the slab brackets the Shetland Gp top (illustrative name) and the bright channel, reversed patch and thin bed built into that layer
names_note: surface names are illustrative: the synthetic layers are named after Norwegian North Sea units (Hordaland Gp, Balder Fm, Shetland Gp, Cromer Knoll Gp, Draupne Fm) in their stratigraphic order; they are not those formations, and their times, thicknesses and amplitudes are invented
